newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile 9-mo bank profits rise 5.5 pct on 1995.
newsitem.headline: Chile 9-mo bank profits rise 5.5 pct on 1995.

text.p: Chile's banking and financial system reported net earnings of 164.8 billion pesos in the first nine months of the year, up 5.5 percent on the same period last year, said the Banking Superintendency.
The data showed profit growth slowing slightly from the eight months to August, when earnings increased 6.5 percent on the same period in 1995.
Banks and financial houses reported total loan portfolios growing 14.5 percent on the first nine months of last year.
Strongest growth continued to be seen in consumer credit loans which climbed 32 percent on the same period 1995.
Trade loans increased 15 percent, while mortgage credits rose 24 percent, said the superintendency.
